newsitem.title: USA: Nebraska fed cattle trade steady $113/dressed-USDA.
newsitem.headline: Nebraska fed cattle trade steady $113/dressed-USDA.

text.p: Trade was fairly active on Wednesday. Steers and heifers were fully steady on a dressed basis delivered (paid on hot carcass weights).
Dressed Basis Steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1200-1350 lbs mostly 113.00, few 112.00-112.50. ( weighted average 112.81 ).
Dressed Basis Heifers - Select and Choice 2-3 1100-1250 lbs mostly 113.00, few 112.00-112.50. ( weighted average 112.89 )
Slaughter steers and heifers fully steady with Tuesday. Buyer inquiry and demand good, seller interest firm.
Live basis sales - Equivalent 3 percent shrink delivered and FOB, some FOB 4% shrink.
Slaughter Steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1225-1300 lbs 70.00-71.00. Slaughter Heifers - Select and Choice 2-3 1100-1250 lbs 70.00-71.00.
Wk To Date - 45,600 Sm Pd Lst Wk- 23,100 Sm Pd Lst Yr- 56,100
